uncertainFacts: BloxInformer currently lists the 1% Legendary dark race as Night Knight, while Beebom, Pro Game Guides, Gamezebo, Destructoid, Kongbakpao, and WizardAlchemy.org use Thestrals for the same dark-race stat line.

BloxInformer writes Undead Maximum Health as 30%, while Beebom, Pro Game Guides, and Destructoid describe the value as a -30% Max HP penalty. The dataset uses -30% Max HP and records the conflict on the row.
Stellar Ambassador chance is 4% in BloxInformer, Beebom, and Pro Game Guides. Gamezebo writes 4-5%, so the dataset uses 4%.

items.name: Human
items.rollRoute: Default starter race or race reroll result
items.mainLimit: No damage, movement, sustain, or defensive bonuses
items.keepPriority: Reroll as soon as you can
items.notes: Human is the default race and mostly exists as the result players try to replace with free or paid rerolls.
items.verificationNote: All checked race tables agree Human is Common at 25% with no bonuses.

items.name: Tree Spirit
items.coreBonus: Life Regeneration x2 and +5% Maximum Health
items.mainLimit: -2 Base Movement Speed and no offensive bonus
items.notes: Tree Spirit can smooth out early fights when healing feels slow, but the movement penalty makes it easy to outgrow.
items.verificationNote: BloxInformer, Beebom, Gamezebo, and PGG agree on the main sustain and movement stats.

items.name: Elf
items.coreBonus: +3 Base Movement Speed and +10 Jump Height
items.mainLimit: No combat, sustain, or element bonus
items.notes: Elf makes movement feel better, especially while exploring, but it does not help damage or survival once enemies get tougher.
items.verificationNote: All checked race tables agree Elf is Uncommon at 15% with movement and jump bonuses.

items.name: Werewolf
items.coreBonus: +10% Maximum Health, +5 Attack Power, +1 Base Movement Speed, +10 Jump Height
items.mainLimit: No element synergy or special passive
items.notes: Werewolf is a practical first upgrade because it gives a little HP, damage, speed, and jump without adding a painful drawback.
items.verificationNote: Sources agree on rarity and roll chance. BloxInformer writes Jump Height as 10; Beebom, PGG, and Gamezebo frame it as +10.

items.name: Death Eater
items.coreBonus: +10% Attack Power and 5% Max HP restored on kill
items.passive: HP restoration after defeating an enemy
items.notes: Death Eater is useful when you are killing enemies quickly because the heal triggers on kills instead of slow passive recovery.
items.verificationNote: BloxInformer, Beebom, PGG, Destructoid, and Gamezebo agree on +10% Attack Power, 5% kill heal, and reduced HP regeneration.

items.name: Undead
items.coreBonus: +10 Skill Speed and a fatal-hit survival passive
items.passive: Keeps 1 HP after fatal damage, enters invincible recovery, and restores 30% HP with a 180 second cooldown
items.notes: Undead can save a run when a hard enemy would kill you, but the lower Max HP makes normal mistakes more dangerous.
items.verificationNote: BloxInformer writes Maximum Health: 30%, while Beebom, PGG, and Destructoid describe this as a -30% Max HP penalty. The dataset uses the penalty because it matches the broader source agreement and the tradeoff described in tier notes.

items.name: Ice Crystal
items.coreBonus: +20% Ice Elemental Damage and +10% Maximum Health
items.notes: Ice Crystal is strongest when your spell setup is built around Ice damage, especially if the extra HP helps offset slower movement.
items.verificationNote: BloxInformer, Beebom, Gamezebo, and PGG agree on the Ice damage, movement penalty, and Max HP bonus.

items.name: Fiendish Demon
items.coreBonus: +20% Fire Elemental Damage and +2 Base Movement Speed
items.notes: Fiendish Demon is the clean Fire build race. The movement bonus feels good, but the Max HP loss punishes sloppy fights.
items.verificationNote: BloxInformer, Beebom, Gamezebo, Destructoid, and PGG agree on the Fire damage, speed bonus, and HP penalty.

items.name: Stellar Ambassador
items.passive: Movement speed burst after landing hits
items.notes: Stellar Ambassador is a strong all-around roll because its Attack Power and Skill Speed help no matter which element you are using.
items.verificationNote: BloxInformer, Beebom, and PGG list 4%. Gamezebo says 4-5%, so 4% is used as the stricter confirmed value.

items.name: Night Knight
items.bestFor: Dark DPS builds and late-game damage
items.coreBonus: +20% Dark Elemental Damage, +10% Attack Power, +3% Base Movement Speed, +30% Jump Height, +30 Skill Speed
items.notes: Night Knight is the 1% dark race. The dark damage bonus, Disaster status, Attack Power, and Skill Speed make it the clearest top roll if the name is confirmed.
items.verificationNote: BloxInformer current New Mainland page lists Night Knight with this 1% dark stat line. Beebom, PGG, Gamezebo, Destructoid, Kongbakpao, and WizardAlchemy.org use Thestrals for the same stat line. The local image is the PGG Thestrals image and should be reviewed against the in-game current name.
